properties.name: nexus.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable Nexus Observability starter integration.

properties.name: nexus.gateway-url
properties.description: The base URL of the Nexus API Gateway.

properties.name: nexus.service-name
properties.description: The name of the client microservice registered with Nexus AI.

properties.name: nexus.metrics-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval in milliseconds for pushing live Micrometer metrics.

properties.name: nexus.internal-token
properties.description: Shared secret token stamped by API Gateway via X-Internal-Token header. Must match INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN.
